question:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.

Competent
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 2** i.e. Qualified.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Competent"** means having the necessary ability, knowledge, or skill to do something successfully. (सक्षम)

 
 
• **Example:** She is a very competent teacher who brings out the best in her students.
 
 
 
• **"Qualified"** refers to having the necessary skills, experience, or knowledge to do a particular job or activity. (योग्य)
 
 
• **Example:** He is well-qualified for the position of a manager.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that the synonym of **'Competent'** is **'Qualified'**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 2 i.e. Qualified**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Dumb** (मूर्ख): Lacking intelligence or good judgment.

 
 
• **Example:** It was a dumb idea to go out in the storm.
 
 
 
• **Chatty** (बातूनी): Fond of talking in an easy, informal way.
 
 
• **Example:** She is very chatty and loves to share stories.
 
 
 
• **Unskilled** (अकुशल): Not having or requiring special skill or training.
 
 
• **Example:** The job was simple and could be done by an unskilled worker.
